title: Symmetric mollification commutes with D and is self-adjoint: ∫ D(η*u)(s) = −∫ u div(η*s) (parent step 2, Fubini part; Simon Ch. 2, 2.5)
statement: Let P ∈ N. Let η : R^P → R be C¹ with compact support and even (η(−z) = η(z) for all z). Let u : R^P → R and s : R^P → R^P be Lebesgue integrable. Write (η*u)(x) = ∫ η(t) u(x − t) dt and (η*s)(z) = ∫ η(t) s(z − t) dt, Mathlib's convolution with lsmul ℝ ℝ and volume. Then ∫ D(η*u)(x)(s(x)) dx = −∫ u(z) div(η*s)(z) dz, where div = trace of the derivative.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (η u : Euclid P → ℝ) (s : Euclid P → Euclid P), ContDiff ℝ 1 η → HasCompactSupport η → (∀ z, η (-z) = η z) → Integrable u → Integrable s → ∫ x, fderiv ℝ (convolution η u (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) x (s x) = -∫ z, u z * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ (convolution η s (ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ) volume) z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)
